events.title: West Saxons Repel Viking Invasion at Ashdown
events.description: King Æthelred I of Wessex and his brother Alfred, later known as Alfred the Great, led a West Saxon army against Danelaw Viking invaders at the Battle of Ashdown and drove them back.
events.significance: The victory was a rare success against the Viking advance in England. It also showed the leadership of Alfred, who later became one of the most celebrated kings in English history.

events.title: The United States Pays Off Its National Debt
events.description: President Andrew Jackson announced a celebratory dinner after the federal government reduced the national debt to zero.
events.significance: It is the only time in American history the national debt has been fully paid off. It remains a landmark in debates over government spending.

events.title: Ibn Saud Is Crowned King of Hejaz
events.description: Abdul-Aziz ibn Saud was crowned King of Hejaz, which gave him authority over the region that contains the holy cities of Mecca and Medina.
events.significance: This was a key step in uniting the territories that became Saudi Arabia, a state he formally proclaimed in 1932.

events.title: Elvis Presley Is Born
events.description: Elvis Presley, the American singer, guitarist and actor, was born on this day. He would become one of the most famous entertainers of the 20th century.
events.significance: Presley helped bring rock and roll into the mainstream and shaped popular music and youth culture around the world. He died in 1977.
